details: Bitcoin's price is consolidating around $63,700, having briefly fallen to a 10-day low near $63,000. This decline is attributed to a sharp sell-off in Asian semiconductor stocks, which spilled over into Wall Street and the crypto market. Investors are maintaining cautious positions ahead of the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy decision and commentary. Additionally, the market is closely watching core PCE inflation and second-quarter GDP data. The past week has seen Bitcoin and Ethereum down by 2.98% and 0.46% respectively, with major altcoins also correcting. The overall market sentiment is risk-off, leading to significant liquidations, predominantly of long positions, as aggressive bullish sentiment lacked support amid uncertain macroeconomic conditions and shifting regulatory policies. U.S.-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced outflows, contributing to the downward pressure.
title: Bitcoin Under Pressure Amid Fed Uncertainty, Tech Sell-Off, and ETF Outflows

details: BNY Mellon is adopting blockchain technology for its record-keeping, a move that could significantly transform the processing and infrastructure of financial markets. The aim is to reduce transaction settlement times and enable 24/7 operation. This development highlights the increasing institutional adoption of blockchain beyond cryptocurrencies and into core financial services.
title: BNY Mellon Embraces Blockchain for Financial Records

details: Tether has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) to pilot blockchain-based tokenized securities and stablecoin settlements. This initiative aims to modernize Africa's financial markets by focusing on digital asset education, securities tokenization through Tether's Hadron platform, and a Kenya-specific AML/KYC framework. The partnership intends to lower investment barriers, speed up settlements, and increase market liquidity, potentially establishing a blueprint for regulated blockchain use across African capital markets.
title: Tether Partners with Nairobi Exchange for Tokenized Securities
